# Wingmates
Nobody should have to learn the ropes alone. Wingmates pairs a newcomer with a crewmate willing to show them around.
- What it is: a first-shift buddy system with two roles — a [bold]seeker[/bold] (the newcomer, looking for help) and a [bold]guide[/bold] (an experienced crewmate willing to show someone around). Matching works station-wide; you do not need to be standing at the same terminal as your match.
- Where to find it: look for the WINGMATE BEACON wallmount, present on every rotation map. Both roles use the same beacon.
- Steps to first success, as a seeker: - Open any Wingmate beacon, pick your department and preferred teaching style, and press "Find a crewmate." - There is no countdown. You can keep working while you wait, and cancel the request at any time. - When a guide offers, you will see their offer at the beacon and can accept, decline, or simply leave it open.
- Steps to first success, as a guide: - Open any Wingmate beacon and read the guide charter in full before agreeing to it — it is the actual conduct standard for the role, not boilerplate. - Press "Volunteer this round." Guide eligibility depends on server policy: some crews are automatically eligible once they meet basic, visible criteria; others require a moderator's approval first. If the Volunteer button will not activate, the beacon tells you the specific reason — read it before asking staff. - Once volunteering, offer to help a visible seeker. Either person can end the pairing at any time, for any reason, with no explanation required.
- Either side can permanently block a specific partner from pairing with them again, this shift and every future shift, at any time.
